## 🎯 Summary

<!-- One or two sentences. Technical terms are fine — this is the abstract, not marketing
copy. What it adds or changes, the route or boundary it lives behind, and any piece you had
to add to make it work. No version numbers and no image digests: they rot in prose. -->

## 🔎 What to review

<!-- Two to four bullets: where a mistake would matter, and what correct looks like. Not a
file list — the diff has that. Delete only when the change is trivial. -->

## 🔑 Key decisions

<!-- One ### per decision, titled with the decision itself, so a reviewer can skim the
headings and stop at the one they disagree with. **Why:** the constraint, two or three
sentences, not the story. **Usage:** the evidence — how many repositories do it, repo
precedent, an upstream default, or "first here". Rejections and deferrals are decisions too,
same shape. Delete the section when nothing here is arguable. -->

### <The decision, as a statement>

**Why:** <the constraint that forces it>
**Usage:** <what others do, or "first here">

## ⚠️ Beware

<!-- Anything to know before this lands: a manual step Flux cannot do, or behaviour that is
irreversible or destructive. Delete the section when there is nothing — never write a line
saying there is nothing to beware of. -->

## 🔗 Related

<!-- Only when applicable: Closes #123, depends on #456, or the stack order. -->
